stem: Based on information presented in the selection, what can the reader conclude about the black-backed woodpecker?

options.label: F
options.text: It prefers to eat small insects but also consumes a variety of fruits and seeds.

options.label: G
options.text: It is better protected from danger when living in a burned forest than when living in an unburned forest.

options.label: H
options.text: It moves from forests in Canada to forests in the United States each year.

options.label: J
options.text: It leaves the burned forest because other birds invade its habitat.
